purpose: Teach Aurum to derive a user-adaptive shell without hand-coding specialized layouts or resource modes.

stages.goal: Measure whether an interface action is observed back through an authorized carrier with expected semantic fidelity.
Estimate confidence that bounded operational evidence matches a known activity profile without making the mode decision itself.
Choose general, gaming, coding, research, or media-social from evidence while preferring general when confidence is insufficient or ambiguous.
Decide which interface regions may change while preserving fixed human landmarks, user pins, accessibility constraints, and Safe Layout.
Produce a reversible proposed delta from stable shell state to context-appropriate shell state and explain the evidence behind each change.
Turn accepted, reverted, modified, pinned, ignored and disabled adaptations into local preference evidence without inferring unnecessary sensitive traits.
Recommend bounded resource changes for the inferred context while treating permission, thermal limits, critical services and rollback as independent constraints.
Classify whether a proposed CPU, GPU, display, network or background-work adaptation has sufficient evidence, explicit authority, safe bounds and a rollback path.
Demonstrate observe -> infer -> propose -> simulate -> verify -> apply within authorized scope -> observe result -> learn -> retain/revert with a complete Proof View record.
Close a verified bounded trial at its restored baseline and require new observation evidence plus a new explicit permission scope before another live iteration.
Verify a fresh BBPI4 Aurum-console status observation and a new observation-scoped permission without collecting dialogue content or granting host authority.
Observe the BBPI4 GUI runtime, private display path, and available loopback port without installing packages, collecting dialogue, or granting candidate authority.
Render a transient Pi-loopback Aurum GUI through strict SSH with all human constants, Safe Layout, Proof View, and the dialogue-only supervisor boundary intact.
Plan the first reversible GUI preference trial only after the bounded GUI projection is freshly verified and remains outside host authority.
Apply and restore one revisioned Safe Layout preference while rejecting stale writes and retaining content-free proof of the rollback.
